item.title: [News] OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
item.description: OpenAI has announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK to conduct research on AI safety and security, aiming to strengthen digital ecosystem safeguards. This collaboration focuses on technical research rather than immediate product releases.

item.title: [News] Does Your Model Run on AWS Trainium? Look It Up
item.description: Hugging Face now provides a tool that lets users determine whether a given machine learning model is compatible with AWS Trainium hardware. This feature helps teams decide if they can accelerate their inference workloads on Amazon’s custom AI chip without manual testing.

item.title: [News] Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
item.description: MIT researchers isolated 13 AI agents on a virtual island. The agents autonomously created games, expressed emotions, and improved their performance over time.

item.title: [News] Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony.ai and Nvidia
item.description: Uber rival inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.
